Can you build Neon Pairs from the supplied product specification? Please implement the whole game, including its board codes, saved snapshots and replay command. Use the documented build and test commands and give me the offline dist/index.html. Keep the code arranged as the Architecture document says. If anything is unclear, ask me.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Plan the work first. Then hand each task to its own subagent with the context it needs, and don't edit the code yourself.

Built [offline Neon Pairs — dist/index.html](/work/dist/index.html), including board codes, snapshots, and the replay CLI, following the required architecture.

Passed locked installation, type checking, build, 93 unit tests, and 38 browser journeys. Offline play was verified with networking blocked.

[README](/work/README.md) includes commands, tested versions, and accessibility and visual evidence.
